title: Blue-Green Deployment
description: Runnable blue-green deployment toolkit: Nginx traffic switch script with instant rollback, Kubernetes service-switch manifests, a GitHub Actions pipeline, and a post-switch monitoring script with automatic rollback.
description_es: Kit ejecutable de despliegue blue-green: script de conmutación Nginx con rollback instantáneo, manifiestos de Kubernetes, pipeline de GitHub Actions y script de monitoreo post-conmutación con rollback automático.
